issues.on_page: Miscellaneous 133,032 (General Fund 89,050); Statement of Activities p2: General government Capital Grants and Contributions 79,556, general revenues Miscellaneous 51,744
issues.issue: The review note says the line is 'not explained', but the Statement of Activities shows 79,556 of general-government capital grants and contributions with no other governmental receipt line to hold them. Most of the General Fund's Miscellaneous 89,050 (detail[5]) is therefore probably capital grants. The grantor isn't printed. The line is about 15% of governmental receipts.

issues.on_page: Other supplies and expenses 30 (Debt Service Fund)
issues.issue: The printed object is 'Other supplies and expenses', but it is recorded as debt interest and fees. This is defensible because the fund statement (p4) counts it in 'Interest and other charges' 23,308.
The business-type cost-type lines carry function 'utilities', but the Water 'Utilities' line (and Sewer 'Utilities' 24,901, detail[73], p18) has no function field.
